Hi Evelyn / Marcus,

Following up from the sourcing calls — Anita Sharma (ex-AI-lab, compression work) is at final stage and has a competing offer. She verbally accepted a technical take-home and is ready to sign, but has pushed back on our standard L5 package.

Summary of proposal (attached: Anita_Sharma_offer_summary.pdf):
- Role: Senior Research Scientist (L5) — reporting to Marcus Lin
- Base we proposed: $220,000 (top of band)
- Candidate counter: $270,000 base + $40k sign-on + 20% refresh after year 1
- Hiring manager asks for: one-time sign-on $30,000 + equity refresh 0.5% (refresh schedule to be defined) and a discretionary base uplift to $245,000 (one-time exception)

Business notes: Marcus strongly requests flexibility due to unique compression expertise, immediate impact on the roadmap, and a time-sensitive competitor cycle. We have budget headroom in the ML research bucket if leadership approves.

Can you advise on approval path for out-of-band base and the ad-hoc onboarding grant? If approved, I will prepare a clean offer with the modified numbers and loop Legal/People Ops for paperwork.

Thanks,

Evelyn / Mina,

Appended is a short impact memo (attached: impact_memo_ML_compression.docx). Key points:
- Anita has a two-year track record shipping compression-aware LLM quantization that reduced token-cost by ~18% at two orgs; we estimate ~12–15% unit-cost improvement for the fine-tuned search model within 6 months. That directly reduces inference spend for the product team and improves latency on edge devices.
- She would own the quantization roadmap for Search and the embedding infra integration; time-to-value estimated 3–6 months.
- Risk: without her we'll likely delay the project by 6–9 months or need an external contractor at higher cost.

Cost delta (requested vs band top):
- Base uplift: requested $245k vs band top $220k = +$25k annualized
- One-time sign-on: requested $30k
- Equity refresh: proposed 0.5% (we propose to describe as a 1.0% total initial grant with a 0.5% refresh after 12 months)

We can absorb $15k of the base uplift from existing hiring buckets; asking for an additional $10k uplift (one-time ongoing base increase) and full sign-on + refresh approval.

If helpful, I can provide a short business case for the revenue/runway impact.

Thanks,
Marcus
Hiring Manager — Search & Retrieval

- Compensation: base uplift to $235k (not the full $245k requested) plus a $25k one-time sign-on is within my discretionary boundary given market scarcity. The 0.5% refresh is OK provided the vesting and performance gates are explicit in the offer.
- I need People Ops to confirm the refresh mechanics and Legal to confirm any precedent language.
- The remaining $10k of base uplift Marcus requested would require Rishi sign-off because it changes the salary structure for L5 on the team.

Action items:
- Mina: if Marcus can accept $235k base + $25k sign-on + 0.5% refresh, prepare the offer packet and include the proposed refresh language.
- Evelyn / Marcus: Rishi looped for escalation if you insist on the extra $10k.

Approving conditionally: Laura Bennett (Comp & People Operations)
